name: Tomfoolery Wood Co.
old_description: Our Pacific Northwest (PNW) furniture balances mid-century modern restraint with natural warmth, using honest materials, natural wood pallets, and thoughtful details to create heirlooms that feel grounded, calm, and deeply connected to our landscape.
about:
Tomfoolery Wood Co. is based in Kent, Washington, with a workshop in Seattle where it designs and handcrafts solid wood furniture. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its operation centers on Pacific Northwest craftsmanship.

The shop produces custom furniture including armoires, benches, bookcases, consoles, dressers, vinyl LP storage units, and tables. Each piece is built from responsibly sourced domestic hardwoods — Willamette Valley walnut, white oak, maple, cherry, madrone, and myrtle — selected by hand and finished with custom stain options. Hardware choices include solid brass pulls or wood edge accent pulls, and some compartments feature height-adjustable shelves. Production is done start-to-finish in the company’s own facility, though headcount and floor space are not disclosed.

Tomfoolery serves residential clients and ships nationally; testimonials cite customers in Seattle, Washington; Drury, Missouri; and Portland, Oregon. The company also works with interior design professionals on bespoke commissions, collaborating from concept through delivery.

The company emphasizes sustainability, partnering with regional mills and restoration projects to use salvaged urban and orchard trees, and employs waste-minimizing processes. Its differentiators include a collaborative design process, locally sourced materials with provenance, and a focus on heirloom-quality construction intended to last generations.
built_on: Custom stain finishes and premium hardware options
lead_time: Approximately 17 weeks to order fulfillment; 8–12 weeks to production start
